en.headline: Former Hong Chi assistant house parent sentenced to 13 years for raping disabled resident
en.dek: The High Court judge described the defendant’s conduct as extremely despicable and noted the absence of any remorse when imposing the term.
body: A former assistant house parent at a Hong Chi Association hostel in Tai Po has been sentenced to 13 years’ imprisonment after being convicted of five counts of rape against an intellectually disabled female resident.

The defendant, Chung Pui-kei, who was 38 at the time of the offences, was found guilty by a jury earlier this year. The offences occurred between 13 July and about 9 August 2024 at the hostel. The victim has mild intellectual disability and a mental age equivalent to that of a child under 10.

Mr Justice Yau Tak-hong said when sentencing on Wednesday that the defendant had taken advantage of the victim’s desire for care, breached trust, and committed the offences with premeditation and repeatedly. The judge described the defendant’s explanation for semen found on the victim’s bedsheet as absurd and said the conduct was extremely despicable, disgusting and shocking, with no reports indicating remorse.
Police said the case was particularly distressing because the defendant abused the trust placed in him as a caregiver. The association has not commented publicly on the sentencing.

zh.headline: 匡智會前助理舍監五度強姦智障女院友 判囚13年
zh.dek: 高等法院法官游德康指被告行為極可鄙、令人厭惡，並無悔意，判處監禁13年。
body: 匡智會轄下大埔區殘疾人士院舍前助理舍監宗培基，被陪審團裁定五項強姦罪成，周三在高等法院被判監禁13年。
被告案發時38歲，於2024年7月13日至約8月9日期間，在院舍五度強姦一名輕度智障女院友。事主自幼發展遲緩，心智約等同不足10歲兒童，屬精神上無行為能力人士。
法官游德康判刑時指，被告利用事主渴望關懷的心理犯案，嚴重違反誠信，有預謀及重複犯案。被告對床單上精液的解釋荒謬絕倫，行為極可鄙、令人厭惡及震驚，沒有任何報告顯示悔意。
警方表示，案件令人痛心之處在於被告以照顧者角色濫用事主信任。匡智會暫未就判刑公開回應。
